Dated: @ § MAR 2021
To,
All State/UT Drugs Controllers,
Sub: Incorporation of Benidipine associated Photosensitivity reaction in the
prescribing Information Leaflet - Reg.
Sir/Madam,
Benidipine are approved by CDSCO and marketed in the country in various dosage
forms.
The National Co-ordination Centre for Pharmacovigilance Programme of India
(NCC-PvPI), functioning at IPC Ghaziabad has forwarded their recommendation
based on ADR reports on certain medicinal products including Benidipine which
were discussed by them in the 16th Signal Review Panel (SRP) under the
programme meeting held on 27.12.2019 with an objective to detect
Signal/Prescribing Information Leaflet change from Indian database and promote
patient safety.
In the meeting, the PvP! has evaluated the Benidipine -ADR on the basis of Individual
Case Study Reports (ICSR) and recommended CDSCO to take necessary steps to
incorporate Benidipine associated Photosensitivity reaction as an adverse drug
reaction in to the prescribing information leaflet (PIL) of the drug Benidipine
formulations marketed in the country.
Subsequently, the PvPI recommendations was deliberated in the Subject Expert
Committee (SEC-Cardiovascular & Renal) meeting held on 04.02.2021 at CDSCO
1

HQR, New Delhi. After detailed deliberation, the Committee has recommended that
Photosensitivity reaction should be incorporated in the package insert ofthe di ,
Benidipine as suggested by PvP.
The recommendation of the SEC has been considered by this office.
Accordingly, you are requested to direct the manufacturers of Benidipine
formulations under your jurisdiction to mention Photosensitivity reaction as an
adverse drug reaction in the Package insert/Promotional Literature of the drug.
Action taken in this regard may be intimated to this office.
Yours faithfully,
=
Dr. V.G Somani
Drugs Controller General (India)
